# Lifecycle Engine

## Rules
- Exports `evaluateLifecycleVerdict`, `projectArtifacts`, `findBlockingParent`, `resolveLifecycleNextHop`; application `evaluateLifecycle` adds command guidance.
- Domain consumes supplied predicate `CheckResult`; no I/O, effects, snapshot fallback, or check execution.
- Effective artifact status preserves review; upstream review creates `pending-parent-artifact-review`. Canonical blockers carry code, message, skippability, bypass, files.
- Workflow topology plus candidate predicates determine valid/available targets; no fixed sequence. `nextHop` selects furthest permitted bypass.
- Recovery and archive use canonical reconciled results; next artifact follows `artifactDag().topologicalOrder()`.

## Constraints
- `Change` persists aggregate/history; DAG state derived.
- Effects never execute in verdict.
- Archive overlap and review overlap differ.
